design.statement: Breezeway Courtyard Villa is expressed as a grounded pale-limestone living plinth, a sculptural stone arrival pavilion and light cream upper bedroom volumes beneath layered warm-bronze and terracotta roofs. Deep shade, tall vertical glazing and teak soffits give the south garden elevation a resort-like Caribbean character, while quieter punched north and east faces preserve arrival-side composure. Glass-railed roof terraces and a generous limestone veranda extend living toward the pool garden.
intentions: Make the upper bedroom bar the unmistakable warm-bronze roof crown.
Use the limestone plinth and pavilion to give the villa a permanent, crafted base.
Keep the north arrival face shaded and composed with restrained openings.
Open the south living rooms fully onto the deep veranda and pool garden.
Use teak soffits and shutters to warm the pale stone and cream stucco palette.
Treat the roof terraces as elevated outdoor rooms behind light glass rails.
